why.problem_solved: Builds the tall double post that will carry the boom later.

why.sets_up_for_later: The following steps add the beams on both sides of it.

review_note: The booklet checks the axle lengths 1:1 (yellow = 3, grey = 5). Which beam holes hold each axle is estimated.
